Auths.Rich.extensions_dimension_is_exact
declarations.statement:
∀ {v : Auths.Rich.Vocabulary} [inst : Auths.Rich.ExtensionLaws v] (parent : Auths.Rich.ChainState v)
  (grant : Auths.Rich.Grant v),
  (Auths.Rich.delegationProjection parent grant).value.extensionsAttenuate = true ↔
    Auths.Rich.extensionsLe (some grant.extensions) parent.scope.extensions

declarations.name: Auths.Rich.extensions_dimension_false_of_stripped
declarations.statement:
∀ {v : Auths.Rich.Vocabulary} [inst : Auths.Rich.ExtensionLaws v] (parent : Auths.Rich.ChainState v)
  (grant : Auths.Rich.Grant v) (pinned : Auths.Rich.CriticalExtensions v),
  parent.scope.extensions = some pinned →
    ∀ {entry : Auths.Rich.CriticalExtension v},
      entry ∈ pinned.entries →
        (∀ candidate ∈ grant.extensions.entries, candidate.id ≠ entry.id) →
          (Auths.Rich.delegationProjection parent grant).value.extensionsAttenuate = false

  (grant : Auths.Rich.Grant v),

    Auths.Rich.certifiedAccepts (Auths.Rich.delegationProjection parent grant) = false

  {grantId : Auths.Rich.GrantId v} {grant : Auths.Rich.Grant v},
  Auths.Rich.delegates parent grantId grant child →
    ∀ (pinned : Auths.Rich.CriticalExtensions v),
      parent.scope.extensions = some pinned →
        child.scope.extensions = some grant.extensions ∧ Auths.Rich.extensionsAttenuate grant.extensions pinned

declarations.statement:
∀ {v : Auths.Rich.Vocabulary} [inst : Auths.Rich.ExtensionLaws v] {start : Auths.Rich.ChainState v}
  {rest : List (Auths.Rich.ChainState v)},
  Auths.Rich.DelegationChain start rest →
    ∀ (pinned : Auths.Rich.CriticalExtensions v),
      start.scope.extensions = some pinned →
        ∀ state ∈ rest,
          ∃ carried, state.scope.extensions = some carried ∧ ∀ entry ∈ pinned.entries, carried.carries entry.id

declarations.name: Auths.Rich.rich_projection_accepts_iff_root_and_scope_depth_checks
declarations.statement:
∀ {v : Auths.Rich.Vocabulary} [inst : Auths.Rich.ExtensionLaws v] (parent : Auths.Rich.ChainState v)
  (grant : Auths.Rich.Grant v),
  Auths.Rich.certifiedAccepts (Auths.Rich.delegationProjection parent grant) = true ↔
    Auths.Rich.rootPreserved parent grant ∧ Auths.Rich.scopeDepthChecks parent grant

declarations.name: Auths.Rich.apply_grant_success_iff_linked_and_projection
declarations.statement:
∀ {v : Auths.Rich.Vocabulary} [inst : Auths.Rich.ExtensionLaws v] (parent : Auths.Rich.ChainState v)
  (grantId : Auths.Rich.GrantId v) (grant : Auths.Rich.Grant v) (child : Auths.Rich.ChainState v),
  Auths.Rich.evaluateGrant parent grantId grant = Auths.Rich.DelegationDecision.accepted child ↔
    Auths.Rich.linked parent grant ∧
      Auths.Rich.certifiedAccepts (Auths.Rich.delegationProjection parent grant) = true ∧
        ∃ (checks : Auths.Rich.scopeDepthChecks parent grant),
          child = Auths.Rich.acceptedNextState parent grantId grant checks

declarations.name: Auths.Rich.apply_grant_success_iff_delegates

∀ {v : Auths.Rich.Vocabulary} [inst : Auths.Rich.ExtensionLaws v] (parent : Auths.Rich.ChainState v)
  (grantId : Auths.Rich.GrantId v) (grant : Auths.Rich.Grant v) (child : Auths.Rich.ChainState v),
  Auths.Rich.evaluateGrant parent grantId grant = Auths.Rich.DelegationDecision.accepted child ↔

declarations.statement:

  {grantId : Auths.Rich.GrantId v} {grant : Auths.Rich.Grant v} {left right : Auths.Rich.ChainState v},
  Auths.Rich.evaluateGrant parent grantId grant = Auths.Rich.DelegationDecision.accepted left →
    Auths.Rich.evaluateGrant parent grantId grant = Auths.Rich.DelegationDecision.accepted right → left = right

declarations.statement:

  (parentDepth childDepth : ℕ),
  Auths.Rich.evaluateAuthorScope parent child parentDepth childDepth = Auths.Rich.AuthorDecision.accepted ↔

declarations.name: Auths.Product.Recovery.unknown_resolves_only_linked

(∀ (old new : Auths.Product.Recovery.AttemptView),
    Auths.Product.Recovery.validTransition old new = true →
      old.stage = Auths.Product.Recovery.Stage.unknown →
        new.stage = Auths.Product.Recovery.Stage.observedByProvider ∧
          old.link = Auths.Product.Recovery.Link.verified ∧
            new.link = Auths.Product.Recovery.Link.verified ∧ new.evidence = true) ∧
  (∀ (views : List Auths.Product.Recovery.AttemptView),
      Auths.Product.Recovery.validChain views →
        ∀ (index : ℕ) (bound : index + 1 < views.length),
          views[index].stage = Auths.Product.Recovery.Stage.unknown →
            views[index + 1].stage = Auths.Product.Recovery.Stage.observedByProvider ∧
              views[index + 1].link = Auths.Product.Recovery.Link.verified ∧ views[index + 1].evidence = true) ∧
    ∀ (declarations : Auths.Product.Recovery.Declarations),
      Auths.Product.Recovery.linkOf (Auths.Product.Recovery.capability declarations).providerLink =

declarations.statement:
(∀ (old new : Auths.Product.Recovery.AttemptView),
    Auths.Product.Recovery.validTransition old new = true →
      new.stage = Auths.Product.Recovery.Stage.observedByProvider →
        new.evidence = true ∧
          Auths.Product.Recovery.hasLink new.link = true ∧
            new.link = old.link ∧
              (old.stage = Auths.Product.Recovery.Stage.responseRecorded ∨
                (old.stage = Auths.Product.Recovery.Stage.attempting ∨
                    old.stage = Auths.Product.Recovery.Stage.unknown) ∧
                  old.link = Auths.Product.Recovery.Link.verified)) ∧
  ∀ (first : Auths.Product.Recovery.AttemptView) (rest : List Auths.Product.Recovery.AttemptView),
    first.stage = Auths.Product.Recovery.Stage.attempting →
      Auths.Product.Recovery.consistent first = true →
        Auths.Product.Recovery.validChain (first :: rest) →
          ∀ (index : ℕ) (bound : index < rest.length),
            rest[index].stage = Auths.Product.Recovery.Stage.observedByProvider →
              rest[index].evidence = true ∧
                rest[index].link = first.link ∧
                  Auths.Product.Recovery.hasLink first.link = true ∧
                    ((first :: rest)[index].stage = Auths.Product.Recovery.Stage.responseRecorded ∨
                      ((first :: rest)[index].stage = Auths.Product.Recovery.Stage.attempting ∨
                          (first :: rest)[index].stage = Auths.Product.Recovery.Stage.unknown) ∧

declarations.statement:
∀ {Action : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Action] (env : Auths.Approval.Environment Action) (identifier : ℕ)
  (requirement : Auths.Approval.Requirement) (approvals : List (Auths.Approval.ApprovalRecord Action)),
  Auths.Approval.approvalDecision env identifier requirement approvals =
    Auths.thresholdCounts requirement.threshold

declarations.name: Auths.Approval.approval_authorized_iff_distinct_quorum
declarations.statement:
∀ {Action : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Action] (env : Auths.Approval.Environment Action) (identifier : ℕ)
  (requirement : Auths.Approval.Requirement) (approvals : List (Auths.Approval.ApprovalRecord Action)),
  requirement.approvers.Nodup →
    (Auths.Approval.approvalDecision env identifier requirement approvals = Auths.Generated.Truth.authorized ↔
      ∃ chosen,
        chosen.Nodup ∧
          chosen ⊆ requirement.approvers ∧
            requirement.threshold ≤ chosen.length ∧
              ∀ principal ∈ chosen,
                ∃ approval ∈ approvals,
                  approval.approver = principal ∧
                    Auths.Approval.verdict env identifier requirement approval = Auths.Approval.Verdict.counted)

declarations.name: Auths.Approval.approval_authorized_meets
declarations.statement:
∀ {Action : Type} [inst : DecidableEq Action] (env : Auths.Approval.Environment Action) (identifier : ℕ)
  (requirement : Auths.Approval.Requirement) (approvals : List (Auths.Approval.ApprovalRecord Action)),
  requirement.approvers.Nodup →
    Auths.Approval.approvalDecision env identifier requirement approvals = Auths.Generated.Truth.authorized →
      Auths.Approval.meets
        (List.map Auths.Approval.ApprovalRecord.approver
          (List.filter
